Arsenal_vs_Liverpool.historical_narrative: One of the most storied fixtures in English football history, renowned for dramatic late goals (Michael Thomas 1989, Arshavin's 4 goals in 2009). The match average of nearly 3 goals per game makes it the highest-scoring classic rivalry in Premier League records.
key_matchup_factors: Fixtures at Emirates Stadium feature an average of 3.2 expected goals (xG) combined
The team scoring first has failed to win in 4 of the last 7 meetings, highlighting volatile momentum swings
Over 65% of goals between these two sides in the modern era occur in the second half

Arsenal_vs_Tottenham Hotspur.historical_narrative: Fierce local rivalry characterized by explosive emotions, high card counts (average 4.8 cards per game), and relentless attacking open-play.
key_matchup_factors: Has produced 9 penalties in the last 11 league encounters
Both teams have scored in 8 of the previous 9 North London derbies

Liverpool_vs_Manchester City.fixture_title: The Modern Premier League Title Decider
Liverpool_vs_Manchester City.historical_narrative: The defining tactical rivalry of the modern era between Klopp/Slot's relentless heavy-metal verticality and Guardiola's structural positional supremacy.
key_matchup_factors: Title races decided by single-point margins in 2018-19 and 2021-22
Fixtures average the highest tactical pressing intensity (combined PPDA under 8.5) in Europe
